name: National Sports Talent Search
benefit: The program will help in finding athletes with natural abilities like anthropometric, physical, and physiological capacities without any anatomical defects among children for admission in Class IV to Class VI.The program will support the growth of Indian sports, especially rural sports. Sports schools at the district, regional, and national levels as well as national and international sports academies will foster the development of athletes' sporting potential and talent. As a result of this, the number of athletes in the nation will increase.
eligibility_rules: The applicant should be a citizen of India. The applicant's age should be between the ages of 8 and 12 years. The applicant is only available to participants who complete the physical efficiency and sports aptitude tests. The program allows players from any Indian state to register. As a result, candidates can obtainthe application should be known in both Hindi and English as well as other regional languages. After six months, students who are unable to register for the program or who are declared ineligible by the program might choose to reapply.
documents_required: Age Proof. Aadhaar Card. Medical certificate. Photograph.
how_to_apply: Mode: Online Step-1: Go to the Official Website of the National Talent Search PortalStep-2: Now click "New Registration" and provide the below details - First Name. - Last Name. - Gender. - Date of Birth. - Email Address. - Mobile Number. - Aadhaar Number. - Click on register now. Step-3: After the registration, login again. Step-4: Create a profile and update it. Step-5: Under the profile, search the scheme name and apply.
